get_dataset_paths: get dataset file paths for a list of datasets on the current cluster
get_time_masks: generate encoding and prediction time masks for spatiotemporal patch sequences
get_breaking_points: find the first differing timestep between video clips to detect breaking points
batch_all_gather: gather tensors from all distributed processes and concatenate them along the batch dimension
pad_tensors: pad a list of tensors to a uniform maximum length along a specified axis
